results.title: Kalbermatten
results.overview: A deposed dictator and a persecuted imam find church asylum in the idyllic mountain village of Kalbermatten. At the community meeting, the proud villagers want to show the poor refugees what democracy is. When a dispute over a vote escalated there, the women quickly abolished men's right to vote by majority vote and replaced the mayor with his wife. Out of defiance, the men join the refugees in the church, where the women have nothing to say. While the imam in the church tries to comfort the disempowered men, the deposed dictator helps the deposed mayor to overthrow his beloved wife.

results.title: Thesis on a Domestication
results.overview: A successful transgender actress decided to adopt a child with her lawyer husband . She juggles her career, marriage, and the adoption in pursuit of domestic happiness, all while trying to embrace her flaws and contradictions and also claim and defend her right to ambition, desire, and security. But that pursuit is eventually thwarted when they visit the actress's hometown.

results.title: Fixing a Popped Balloon (aka Phantom Suicides)
results.original_title: Fixing a Popped Balloon (aka Phantom Suicides)
results.overview: After experiencing a psychotic break, a transgender video artist reflects on her past and her complicated relationship with movies.

results.title: M+L
results.overview: Two sisters come to their "shelter" for the summer. Here, at their grandmother's house, each of them is hiding from an important decision. One is hesitant about moving to Australia, while the other is trying to figure out her relationship.  The old house, the overgrown apple garden, the warm evenings by the fire — everything seems frozen in time... But summer can't last forever.

results.title: The Wash
results.overview: The Wash is a short docufiction set in a gay cruising spot in an open desert area in Southern California. Through an excavation of queer artifacts, local lore and gossip, the film documents an assemblage in flux. The Wash is a mirage of sorts. Like a junkyard of vernacular installation art designed for pleasure.

results.title: Game On
results.overview: As she creates her 50th game, legendary designer Brenda Romero leads her team through the highs and hurdles of game development, balancing motherhood, leadership, and creativity.

results.title: Asian Tour 2025: The Movie
results.overview: Take a look back and enjoy the highlights from the FC Barcelona tour of Japan and South Korea.

results.title: Portraits of the Apocalypse
results.overview: Four interconnected stories reveal the beginning and evolution of a zombie apocalypse in Buenos Aires. Through the eyes of different characters, we experience the initial confusion, the uncontrolled chaos, and the struggle for survival in a devastated world.

results.title: Curious Varvara and the New Year
results.overview: Events unfold on the eve of the New Year: a play is being prepared, children are waiting for gifts, adults are fussing. But a mysterious incident threatens to ruin the holiday for everyone at once. Varvara and her faithful friend Vasya immediately get down to business. Santa Claus himself helps them in the investigation, although he is not real. While everyone is talking about miracles, Varvara prefers to look for answers with the help of logic, because for her the New Year is a great reason to reveal another mystery.

results.title: HalfPast
results.overview: A series of four micro films that serve as narrative film and branded apparel line.

results.title: Two Pianos
results.overview: Returning to France after a long exile, pianist Mathias Vogler reunites with his mentor, Elena, to prepare a concert. In a park, an encounter with a child who looks just like him will lead him to Claude, the woman he once loved.

results.title: Home Sweet Home
results.overview: When Gośka meets Grzesiek online, she's sure he's her Mr. Right. Grzesiek is crazy about her, showers her with flowers, and proposes in Venice, but soon enough, the picture perfect romance starts to crumble, revealing a darker side.

results.title: On the Rungs of Jacob's Ladder
results.original_title: On the Rungs of Jacob's Ladder
results.overview: A documentary about the movie Jacob's Ladder by Didier Allouch with Adrian Lyne, Tim Robbins, and Bruce Joel Rubin.  Included on the 4K release of Jacob's Ladder.

results.title: The Blithefield Romance
results.overview: The Hawthorne Society and Eternity Box Films welcome you inside the mind of Nathaniel Hawthorne.  "The Blithedale Romance" is his most personal and revealing novel.  Based on his experiences at Brook Farm and his personal relationships with Herman Melville and Margaret Fuller, the novel reveals Hawthorne's secret desires.

results.title: Sons of Ecstasy
results.overview: An unusual rivalry sits at the epicenter of the 1990s ecstasy drug trade in Arizona. A British stockbroker faces off against the son of a notorious New York mobster. Underground raves set the stage for a deadly battle over control of an ecstasy empire.

results.title: Objects In Mirror Are Closer Than They Appear
results.overview: Jacob believed he was a good man. Believed. After a long day at work, tired and frustrated Jacob drives his car home. He accidentally hits a person on a bicycle with his vehicle. Due to shock and panic, decides to flee the scene...

results.title: Enemigos
results.overview: Chimo turns 18 years and comes from a humble and supportive family. Since childhood he was bullied and even today, while working multiple jobs and dreaming of starting his own business, he continues to face his bully: El Rubio. When Chimo has the opportunity for revenge, he never imagines what begins as an act of retaliation could turn into an unexpected friendship that'll change both their lives.
